Evidence-led essays on the points where Yemen’s financial-inclusion data change the question—not just the answer. Each Reading is traceable to the evidence behind it.

Featured reading

Evidence periodGlobal Findex fieldwork November 2022 – January 2023 · point-of-sale (POS) counts March 2025 – June 2026 · institutional records June–August 2026
The system is changing. What has reached people?
Yemen’s rules, institutions and payment infrastructure have moved faster than its representative evidence about people. The gap between the two is not an answer to guess; it is the next thing to measure.

All readings

  1. Evidence periodReference years 2021–2024 · CBY-Aden annual reports 2024 and 2025 · IMF Article IV consultation 2025
    Same year, different number
    When two official reports give different remittance values for the same year, what changed: the economy or the measurement?
  2. Evidence periodPositions at end-2022 as published in the 2022 annual report and restated from 2023 · valuation change of January 2023
    When the baseline moves
    When the same year’s banking positions are published at higher levels in a later report, how much of the jump is the economy and how much is the measurement?
  3. Evidence periodGlobal Findex fieldwork 2022–2023 · point-of-sale (POS) counts March 2025 – June 2026 · project baseline January 2025, target 2030
    When the unit changes, the story changes
    Are we counting people, accounts, active accounts, subscribers, wallets, terminals or transactions?
  4. Evidence periodProvider data 2016–2019, from a 2020 study of five e-money providers
    When does digital growth become durable use?
    Does growth in electronic-money accounts and transactions represent durable voluntary financial use?
  5. Evidence periodBorrower, saver and portfolio observations for end-2015, end-2020 and 2023 · licensed-bank list checked on 3 October 2026
    What exactly do we mean by microfinance growth?
    What does the microfinance record show when borrower counts, saver/depositor measures and nominal portfolio do not move together?
  6. Evidence periodGlobal Findex, Yemen fieldwork 7 November 2022 – 9 January 2023
    The gender gap is measured. Its explanation is still open.
    What do we know about the gender gap in account ownership, and what would it take to explain it?
  7. Evidence periodWorld Bank Yemen Enterprise Survey, September 2022, seven governorates · SMEPS programme report for 2024
    How can 22% and 91.84% both be right?
    In a 2022 survey of formal firms in seven governorates, how can 22% name access to finance as a business challenge while 91.84% of a filtered group rate it a major or moderate obstacle?
  8. Evidence periodPoint-of-sale (POS) counts March 2025 – June 2026 · institutional records June–August 2026 · project results framework January 2025
    When does a payment reform become financial inclusion?
    When a new rail, regulation or programme exists, what evidence would show that it changed financial inclusion?
  9. Evidence periodWorld Bank and G2Px material, May 2024 · reference period of the recipient figure not recorded
    The payment arrived. What happened next?
    When a cash transfer is paid into an account, what would show that the account became part of the recipient’s financial life?
